newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui & Co shares rise briefly to 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui & Co shares rise briefly to 1997 high.

text.p: Shares in Mitsui & Co Ltd rose briefly to touch a high for this calendar year in early Tokyo trading on Tuesday following the trading house's earnings announcement, brokers said.

As of 0144 GMT, the shares were unchanged at 1,000 yen after rising briefly to 1,030, their highest level for this calendar year. Turnover was 2.87 million, the sixth-biggest volume on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

Earlier on Tuesday, Mitsui announced that its parent current profit grew six percent to 60.45 billion yen in the year which ended in March. The firm also forecast the profit will grow further by 9.3 percent this fiscal year.
